test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following states in India, during October to December, receive rainfall due to Northeast monsoon?

options.text: Tamil Nadu, Kerala and Andhra Pradesh
Andhra Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh and Karnataka
Uttar Pradesh, Bihar and West Bengal

solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu, Kerala and Andhra Pradesh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Northeast monsoon,** also known as **winter monsoon,** brings rainfall in the** southern part of India** from **October to December.**
 
• **Tamil Nadu, Kerala, and Andhra Pradesh **are the states that receive rainfall due to** Northeast monsoon** during this period.
 
• **Punjab, Haryana, and Madhya Pradesh **are located in the **northern part **of India and** do not** receive rainfall due to Northeast monsoon.
 
• **Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka** are located in the** southern part** of India but only Andhra Pradesh receives rainfall due to Northeast monsoon.
 
 
• Karnataka receives rainfall during **Southwest monsoon** from **June to September.**
 
 
 
• **Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, and West Bengal** are located in the **northern and eastern parts **of India and **do not** receive rainfall due to Northeast monsoon.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Northeast monsoon **is caused by the** reversal of wind direction** over the Indian Ocean, which brings **moisture from the Bay of Bengal **to the southern part of India.
 
• **Tamil Nadu** is the state that receives the **highest amount of rainfall** due to** Northeast monsoon,** followed by **Kerala and Andhra Pradesh.**
 
• **Punjab, Haryana, and Madhya Pradesh** are located in the** arid and semi-arid regions **of India and receive most of their rainfall during **Southwest monsoon.**
 
• **Andhra Pradesh** receives rainfall both during S**outhwest monsoon and Northeast monsoon** due to its location on the east coast of India.
